title: Rep. Ro Khanna Disclosed 13 Stock Trades, Including a Clorox Sale of $1M-$5M
content:
Rep. Ro Khanna (CA-17) disclosed 13 stock transactions on November 5, 2026, dated October 2 to October 21: 11 purchases and 2 sales, including a Clorox sale in the $1,000,001–$5,000,000 band.

Transaction dates: Oct 2, Oct 13 and Oct 21, 2026. Disclosure date: Nov 5, 2026 (15 to 34 days later). Member: Rep. Rohit “Ro” Khanna, CA-17 (House). Bargo lists some lines twice (NNN, Netflix, Micron, Marvell); they are shown as listed and may reflect separate accounts or lots.

What's been disclosed

  • One large sale: Clorox (CLX), $1,000,001–$5,000,000, on October 13.
  • Purchases on October 21: NNN REIT, Netflix, Micron (MU), Marvell (MRVL) and Gaming and Leisure Properties (GLPI), each $1,001–$15,000 per line. Netflix also shows one $1,001–$15,000 sale that day.
  • Purchases on October 2: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) and American Express (AXP), $1,001–$15,000 each.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Marvell about 36.8% lower on November 9 than on October 21 and Micron about 19.8% lower, while Clorox, sold on October 13, is about 25.0% higher.
  • Timing: the filing came 15 to 34 days after the trades, inside the 45-day window.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
15 to 34 days after the trades, which were dated October 2 to October 21. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the November 9 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
